description: This file declares internal classes and templates used for string splitting operations in the Abseil C++ library, including ConvertibleToStringView, SplitIterator, and Splitter classes, which facilitate splitting strings and converting split results into various container types.

classes.name: ConvertibleToStringView
classes.description: A class that can be implicitly constructed from various string types, excluding rvalue strings, to facilitate safe string conversions.

classes.name: SplitIterator
classes.description: An iterator class that enumerates parts of a string split by a Splitter, used internally for iteration over split substrings.

classes.name: Splitter
classes.description: A class that splits a string based on a delimiter and predicate, providing range-based iteration and implicit conversions to containers and pairs.

methods.name: ConvertibleToStringView
methods.description: Constructors for creating a ConvertibleToStringView from various string types.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator returning the current split substring.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Arrow operator returning pointer to current split substring.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Pre-increment operator advancing the iterator to the next split substring.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the split range.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the split range.
